evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure telemetry is null throughout the run.
Growth requires temperature, tube pressure, and exhaust O2 measurements; the missing pressure gauge prevents verification of the atmosphere.
Exhaust O2 was 7.3 ppm before growth.
O2 has increased monotonically during growth from 12.0 ppm at 2520 s to 44.7 ppm; this raises concern about atmosphere control but does not identify a specific fault.
Temperature is 750.3 C against 750 C setpoint, Ar is 99.9 sccm against 100 sccm, and status is running; these do not verify tube pressure.

args.missing_evidence: A calibrated tube-pressure measurement and growth-stage pressure/O2 acceptance limits are needed to verify the atmosphere; if deviations are confirmed, leak and exhaust-path checks are needed to identify the cause. No sample characterization is available.
